behavior: Opening page only lists owned terminals. A deliberate New action allocates a stable terminal identity.
Original model retains before attaching, waits for xterm render acknowledgement, validates output sequence and enforces input byte limits.
Input and resize use shared inputSequence, ordered dispatch, stable UUID per submission, and acknowledgement only after confirmed Host receipt.
Unknown input ends the attachment without replay; helper has a bounded per-attachment input ledger.
Hidden document detaches the screen while keeping process retention; remount requests a new snapshot.
Page disposal detaches streams and models without closing terminal processes; Native ownerId cleanup must also cancel streams when WK is destroyed.
Input confirmation must match both requestId and inputSequence before synthesizing the model acknowledgement.
limits: No real Host terminal was created, attached, typed into or closed in this work.
Actual WK display, focus, IME, sizing and owner teardown await root independent GUI verification.
Remote device ownership filters visible terminals; this is not the whole original Host terminal roster.
Frozen Remote input does not forward the typed field used by original agent-terminal takeover semantics.
Full Dockkit split/tab layout, global terminal shortcut configuration and persisted cleanup/recovery ownership are broader integration work.
